title: BenchmarkObservation
description: A single benchmark or validation test result captured during the Proof Receipt protocol. v0.1.

test_name.description: Human-readable test name (e.g., 'ResNet18 GPU functional test').

test_origin.description: Where the test was executed and by whom.

observed_output.description: Structured snapshot of the test's reported metrics. v0.1 is permissive on schema inside this block; CLI lints for empty objects.

duration_seconds_if_known.description: Wall-clock duration of the test if measured.

evidence_locator.description: Operator-resolvable path or URL to the raw test artifact (stdout log, screenshot, report). MUST be non-empty for HONEY-eligible receipts.

confidence.description: Operator confidence in the test result. Local-only tests should generally be 'medium'; platform_remote and third_party generally 'high'.

limitations.description: Plain-text statement of what this test does NOT establish (e.g., 'single-pass functional check; does not establish sustained inference throughput over hours').

executed_by.description: The operator or remote-platform service that executed this test (free text; e.g., 'vast remote validator', 'local CI worker swarm-ci-01').
